name: Ruins of the Starstone Golem
introDiscord: Broken celestial statues litter an ancient ruin. Several are merely statues. Several are Starstone Golems. Shizuki's notes indicate she solved this problem by naming one Pebbles.
introTwitch: Broken celestial statues litter an ancient ruin. Several are merely statues. Several are Starstone Golems. Shizuki's notes indicate she solved this problem by naming one Pebbles.

ruins-of-the-starstone-golem-approach.prompt: Three paths wind through motionless stone figures.

left.message:
A Berry rests on a small golem-shaped rock.

Shizuki wrote: "Pebbles. Do not insult Pebbles. Pebbles has seniority."

right.message: A star-chart coffer rests beneath a collapsed statue.

forward.message:
A statue turns its head.

Not Pebbles.

Definitely not Pebbles.

ruins-of-the-starstone-golem-depths.prompt: The ruins narrow between towering stone guardians.

left.message: A Starstone Golem wakes with all the subtlety of a collapsing building.

right.message:
Shizuki's tonic sits beside Pebbles.

"Pebbles guarded this.

Probably.

Pebbles has not moved."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic under Pebbles' vigilant and completely motionless protection.

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary lies inside a shattered golem torso.

ruins-of-the-starstone-golem-threshold.prompt: Three final routes lead toward Ruined Firmament.

left.message: Star Candies glitter beneath a fallen celestial statue.

right.message:
Another Starstone Golem wakes.

Pebbles would never.

forward.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Emergency rock-related medicine. Pebbles exempt."

bossPromptDiscord:
The ruins begin trembling.

Pebbles does not move.

Something considerably larger does.

Use /yes to enter Ruined Firmament or /no to remain with the only trustworthy rock here.
bossPromptTwitch:
The ruins begin trembling.

Pebbles does not move.

Something considerably larger does.

Use !yes to enter Ruined Firmament or !no to remain with the only trustworthy rock here.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat toward Pebbles.

Pebbles provides emotional support by continuing to be a rock.

boss.revealText:
Starstone plates lock together around a blazing core.

Meteorheart Golem awakens!

completionText:
"The Meteorheart Golem collapses.

Pebbles remains standing.

Technically Pebbles wins."
